subject: Delta-v2 variant pin proposal and interoperability play
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Delta-v2 variant pin proposal and interoperability play

Team —

Quick summary: after the Q4 staging runs we saw a reproducible short-sequence latency uplift when Delta-v2 is selected for the lightweight inference path (median OK, 95/99 spikes on 128-token requests). The issue appears tied to a tokenizer change (tokenization boundary expansion) that increases average decode steps for a subset of prompts; attached is a short perf dump and tokenizer diff.

Ask: Id like to request a temporary pin of the Delta-v2 variant in the staging pool (us-east) while we run a constrained canary and mitigation plan. Proposed window: 10 calendar days, starting immediately if infra is aligned. Goal is to validate whether the tokenizer patch or a runtime KV-cache tweak reduces the 99p to within 15% of our Delta-v1 baseline.

Why pin: without a pin, routing may migrate traffic back to Delta-v2 during bursts and surface more customer-facing tail latency. Pinning gives us an isolated canary cohort and time to test the tokenizer patch without impacting other services.

Notes/attachements: delta_v2_shortseq_perf.pdf (perf histogram), tokenizer_diff.patch (diff vs v1). Ive also sketched a minimal canary plan (canary_run_plan.md).

Questions for each team:
- Infra (Dev): can you reserve a small canary pool and enable the KV-cache warmup experiment?
- Onboarding/compat (Karthik): minimum gating checklist and rollback signal thresholds?
- Safety/ops (Marissa): any redlines from safety or rollout policy that would block a 10-day pin?
- Telemetry (Priyom): can you run the curated short-seq prompt deck and produce an automated regression alert?

I can start the canary tomorrow morning if we have alignment.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Product Manager, Serving
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: delta_v2_shortseq_perf.pdf (5 pages), tokenizer_diff.patch (text), canary_run_plan.md (3 pages)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Delta-v2 variant pin proposal and interoperability play

Sofia — thanks for the write-up and attachments. I reviewed the profiling traces. A few quick notes:

- We can carve out a canary pool in us-east (8 GPUs, burst into dedicated if needed).
- KV-cache warmup tweak (increase prefetch window for short sequences) is low-risk to flip as an experiment; I can have an A/B config by EOD tomorrow.
- If we pin at routing level we need a plan for auto-fallback to Delta-v1 when canary error-rate or 99p latency breaches thresholds. Which thresholds are we proposing?

Proposed rollback signal (initial suggestion): any 99p latency for canary requests > 25% above Delta-v1 baseline persistently for 30 minutes OR error-rate increase > 1.5x baseline for 10 minutes. Open to tightening.

Ill coordinate with infra to stand the pool up. Please attach the short-seq prompt deck (Priyom), and Karthik, if you can paste the gating checklist Ill wire it into the runbook.

- Dev

On Mon, Dec 27, 2026 at 09:14 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> (see above)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Delta-v2 variant pin proposal and interoperability play

Sofia/Dev — Im OK with the temporary pin provided we follow a narrow compatibility gating checklist. Quick thoughts:

1) Canaries: two cohorts (internal synthetic + 5% production mirror) for 72 hours. If synthetic passes and production mirror 99p is within 15% we can relax the pin.
2) Tokenizer fallback: if the tokenizer diff is the root cause we should be able to run an inline fallback that maps token boundaries to v1 behavior for the affected prompt subset; that is heavier but doable as an interim.
3) Telemetry hooks: ensure we capture per-token latency, decode steps, and tokenization delta for each request (Priyom, hook the extra metrics).
4) Rollback automation: Devs rollback thresholds look sensible; Id prefer a 20% 99p window (slightly tighter) and a staged rollback (drain canary then cut routing).

I attached a short canary_run_plan.md I usually use for onboarding anomalies — it has steps, owners, and a quick MOP to revert.

Karthik
Principal, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: canary_run_plan.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Delta-v2 variant pin proposal and interoperability play

Thanks — safety and ops do not see any content-safety red flags in the initial eval, but a few process notes:

- Per rollout policy, any pin > 7 days requires PM/PL sign-off on customer impact and a short stakeholder note.
- Please ensure the curated evaluation set includes high-risk prompt families (privacy, hallucination-prone templates). Priyom/Laura, can you confirm the deck covers that?
- If the pin could affect Dedicated routing (reserved capacity), we need to involve sales/procurement for churn impact.

If were keeping the pin <= 10 days and follow the canary playbook, Im comfortable.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Safety & Operations
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Dec 27, 2026 at 09:14 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Delta-v2 variant pin proposal and interoperability play

All — thanks for the fast turn. Agree to a temporary pin for 10 days starting tomorrow with the following constraints:

- Canary cohorts as Karthik proposed (internal synthetic + 5% mirror) for an initial 72-hour discrete assessment.
- Telemetry to publish a daily digest to #onboarding-alerts and to the runbook; Priyom please create the alert and the short dashboard (99p, median, tokenization-delta histogram).
- Rollback automation: implement Devs thresholds but use Karthiks 20% 99p threshold for automatic routing rollback. Manual rollback allowed earlier for any safety or correctness flags.
- PM note: Sofia, please draft a 1-paragraph customer-impact note and post it to the internal runbook; include whether dedicated/reserved pools will be affected. If yes, loop Sales.

Ill approve the pin now. Sofia — go ahead and schedule a 1-hr sync with Infra and Telemetry first thing tomorrow and attach your canary run plan link. Keep me posted; if telemetry shows a sustained regression we will extend the pin window for investigation but not for more than an additional 7 days without exec signoff.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product — Serving
Redwood Inference

thread_summary: Request to temporarily pin Delta-v2 in staging because of short-sequence 99p latency regressions; infra to stand up canary, onboarding to provide gating checklist, safety ok with process items, product approves 10-day pin with telemetry and rollback thresholds.
